app.name: Niro
app.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

login.title: Welcome to Niro
login.body: Log in with Discord to manage Niro in your servers.
login.privacy: Niro only reads your username, avatar and server list. It never sees your password or messages.
login.failed: Login didn't work. Please try again.

servers.title: Your servers
servers.subtitle: Servers where you're the owner or have Manage Server.
servers.empty: You don't manage any servers yet. You need Manage Server permission in a server to set up Niro there.
servers.addedHint: Just added Niro? It can take up to a minute to show up here.

guild.modulesSubtitle: Turn features on or off. Changes apply in Discord immediately.
guild.saveFailed: Couldn't save that change. It was undone.
guild.notInServerTitle: Niro isn't in this server yet
guild.notInServerBody: Add Niro to start configuring it.

moderation.name: Moderation
moderation.description: Warnings, timeouts, kicks and bans with a numbered case history, plus Discord AutoMod management.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: Stops hacked accounts, scam links and raids, and audits dangerous permissions.

logging.name: Logging
logging.description: Logs message edits and deletions, member changes and server changes to the channels you choose.

roles.name: Role panels
roles.description: Buttons and menus that let members pick their own roles.

welcome.name: Welcome
welcome.description: Greets new members and says goodbye, with optional automatic roles.

tickets.name: Tickets
tickets.description: Private support tickets with staff roles and transcripts.

status.comingSoon: Settings arrive in a later milestone

modSettings.title: Moderation settings
modSettings.subtitle: How moderation commands behave in this server.
modSettings.logChannelHelp: Every case is posted here. Niro needs permission to send messages in it.
modSettings.dmUsersHelp: Send members a private message when they are warned, timed out, kicked or banned. Moderators can skip it per action with the silent option.
modSettings.requireReasonHelp: Moderators must give a reason for every action.
modSettings.moduleOff: The Moderation module is turned off. Settings are kept, but commands won't run until you turn it on in Modules.

cases.title: Cases
cases.subtitle: Every moderation action, newest first.
cases.deleteConfirm: Delete case #{{number}} from the history? It is kept in the audit trail and marked as deleted in the log channel.
cases.notFound: This case doesn't exist (or was deleted).

automod.title: AutoMod
automod.subtitle: Discord's built-in AutoMod, managed from here. Rules run on Discord's side, instantly, even if Niro is offline.
automod.presetsSubtitle: Ready-made rules you can add with one click and adjust later.

invite_links.name: Block invite links
invite_links.description: Stops links to other Discord servers.

scam_phrases.name: Common scam phrases
scam_phrases.description: Blocks "free Nitro", fake giveaways and similar bait.

mention_spam.name: Mention spam
mention_spam.description: Blocks messages with 6+ mentions and times out the sender for 10 minutes.

form.name: Name
form.keywordsHelp: One per line. Use * as a wildcard, e.g. *scam* or free nitro*.
form.regexHelp: Optional. One per line, up to 10.
form.allowListHelp: One per line. Messages with these are never blocked.
form.exemptHelp: Members with these roles or messages in these channels are ignored.

errors.botUnavailable: The bot isn't responding right now. Make sure it's online and try again.

guardianSettings.title: Guardian settings
guardianSettings.subtitle: Protection against hacked accounts, scam links and raids. Changes apply immediately.
guardianSettings.moduleOff: The Guardian module is turned off. Settings are kept, but nothing is checked until you turn it on in Modules.
guardianSettings.modeHelp: Start in monitor mode to see what Guardian would do before it acts.

modes.enforce: Enforce: delete, quarantine and start raid mode

guardianSettings.alertChannelHelp: Where Guardian posts alerts with Restore / Ban buttons. Use a channel only moderators can see.
guardianSettings.burstEnabled: Detect the same message in many channels
guardianSettings.burstEnabledHelp: Hacked accounts usually post one scam link everywhere at once.
guardianSettings.quietDaysHelp: A member silent this long who suddenly posts a link adds suspicion to other signals. Never enough on its own. 0 turns it off.
guardianSettings.scamEnabledHelp: Known scam domains, look-alikes of Discord and Steam, links whose text shows a different site, and typical scam messages. Niro never opens the links.
guardianSettings.domainsHelp: One domain per line, for example example.com. Subdomains are included.

quarantineModes.timeout: Time out (works everywhere, up to 28 days)
quarantineModes.role: Replace their roles with a quarantine role

guardianSettings.quarantineRoleHelp: Set up its channel permissions yourself, for example to only see one help channel. Their old roles are saved and given back on Restore.
guardianSettings.dmUserHelp: Explains how to secure a hacked account and to contact your moderators.
guardianSettings.raidRaiseVerification: Raise the verification level to High during raid mode
guardianSettings.raidSlowmodeHelp: 0 leaves slowmode alone. Everything raid mode changes is undone when it ends.
guardianSettings.minAgeHelp: Accounts younger than this when they join get the action below. 0 turns the gate off.
guardianSettings.verifyRoleHelp: Members get this role by pressing the Verify button. Post the button with /guardian verify-panel.
guardianSettings.exemptHelp: Members with these roles are never checked. Server owners and members who can manage messages are always trusted.

detections.title: Detections
detections.subtitle: What Guardian found and did, newest first. Message text is never stored.
detections.raidOnBody: New invites are paused and the server is stricter. Ends {{ends}}.
detections.raidOffBody: Turn it on by hand if you see a raid Guardian missed.
detections.startRaidConfirm: Start raid mode now? Invites are paused and verification is raised until you end it.
detections.banConfirm: Ban {{user}}? Their messages from the last day are deleted too.

signals.masked_link: Link text shows a different site

problemText.left_server: The member left before Guardian could act.
problemText.bot_role_too_low: Niro's role isn't above this member's highest role. Move Niro's role higher.
problemText.target_is_owner: The server owner cannot be restricted.
problemText.restrict_failed: Restricting the member failed. Check that Niro can time out members and manage roles.
problemText.delete_failed: Some messages could not be deleted. Check that Niro can manage messages there.
problemText.kick_failed: Kicking failed. Check that Niro can kick members.
problemText.verification_failed: Raising the verification level failed (needs Manage Server).
problemText.slowmode_failed: Slowmode could not be set in some channels (needs Manage Channels).

audit.title: Security audit
audit.subtitle: Dangerous permissions and settings in this server. Read-only: nothing is changed.
audit.webhooksUnchecked: Webhooks were not checked: Niro needs the Manage Webhooks permission to list them.

findings.everyone_dangerous: @everyone has {{permissions}}: every member can use these.
findings.bot_admin: Bot {{subject}} has Administrator. If that bot is compromised, so is your server.
findings.self_admin: Niro has Administrator. It doesn't need it: remove it and keep the permissions from the invite.
findings.webhooks: {{count}} webhooks can post in this server. Anyone with a webhook's URL can post as anyone: delete the ones you don't use.
findings.verification_none: The verification level is None: brand-new accounts can post right away.
findings.verification_low: The verification level is Low. Medium or higher slows down throwaway accounts.
findings.no_moderator_mfa: Moderators don't have to use two-factor authentication (Server Settings → Safety Setup).
